patch.value: Chinese (zh) locale for package-owned UI strings

Add a Chinese (zh) locale catalog for the package-owned SPA UI strings (auth, nav, banners, settings, consent, dialog, error mapping). Register zh in locale resolution and the settings language selector (English/Deutsch/Espanol/中文). Legal pages remain an operator concern and are not translated by this package.

zh.json catalog exists with all en keys translated to natural Simplified Chinese (您 formal register); zh registered in SUPPORTED_LOCALES and resolveLocale (zh and zh-CN prefix match); settings language selector offers English/Deutsch/Espanol/中文; npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test green; catalog-parity test covers zh automatically

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Review feedback addressed on feat/i18n-zh-locale (PR #45):

1. public/index.html first-paint inline script: replaced hardcoded \|\| locale chain and nested if/else with a supported-locales array + indexOf check (array-driven).
2. public/src/i18n.ts localeDate(): replaced nested ternary locale→BCP47-tag mapping with a compile-time-complete `Record<SupportedLocale,string>` lookup (LOCALE_TAGS).
3. public/src/views/settings.ts language selector: replaced chained ternary label selection with a `Record<SupportedLocale,string>` lookup (LOCALE_LABEL_KEYS) — eliminates the mislabel-future-locale-as-Chinese risk from the default branch.

Verification: npm run typecheck green; npm run build green; npm test 106/106 pass.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Release attribution corrected to 2026.7.17-1 after review. The first attribution used the item's last-activity DATE, which is unsound: an item can be touched before the release that finally carried its code. Verified instead by tag containment — git tag --contains 5e13307 reports 2026.7.17-1 as the first release holding the implementation commit. Greptile caught this on PR #67 by noticing a historical release predating its implementation.

patch.value: Before this closeout the item had remained in_progress with no activity since its work shipped, so the delivery was missing from the changelog while still being counted as open work in every fleet audit. Closing it with an explicit release attribution is what added the historical entry.
A closed item whose changelog entry appears under the 2026.7.17-1 heading, the first release actually containing 5e13307, leaving the current release notes untouched.

An earlier revision of this record said 2026.7.18; that came from matching the item's last-activity DATE to a release and is superseded.
